evidence_items.publisher: PNAS Nexus; institutional record at UCL Discovery
evidence_items.explanation: The study estimates a 25% relative reduction in Stack Overflow activity within six months of ChatGPT's release, using less-exposed comparison platforms. It examines content creation and reports no significant deterioration in post quality that would explain the loss as merely low-quality material.

An independent analysis covering data through March 2023 also finds reduced question creation. Its contrasting finding of no decline in Reddit developer communities limits any generalization to all human-content sources.

evidence_items.explanation: The report describes GPT-4 as pretrained on document prediction and documents further output improvements from post-training. It supports the training-dependence component, without establishing that an ever-growing supply of new human text is the only route to improvement.
